selected_observations.excerpt: Helion Robotics Ltd is the operating name used in CRM. Invoices and Companies House use Helion Robotics Limited. That is the same legal entity. Helion Industrial Systems Ltd is a different company; it sold sensors to us in 2018 and has no current MSA.

selection_rationale: Explicit same-entity assertion for billing:Helion Robotics Limited ↔ crm:HEL-441 must ground in authoritative prose, not mechanical name similarity alone.
known_missing_information: Pairs without explicit sameness language in commercial_notes may only support REJECT or UNRESOLVED, not ACCEPT.
